_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Pirate's Trove#000.dst: {p} の外、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Damiral と話す

Pirate's Trove#001.src: Lo, adventurer! Welcome to the great province of Gavel, home of the villager race, and yours truly. You'll be headed into the grand citadel of {p} soon!
Pirate's Trove#001.dst: おお、冒険者よ！偉大なる Gavel 地方へようこそ。村人族の故郷であり、この俺の故郷だ。もうすぐ壮大な城塞都市 {p} に入るぞ！
Pirate's Trove#001.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#002.src: But enough with the pleasantries. Tell me... have you ever heard the tale of the great pirate, Captain Hastor? Sailed the seas a long time ago.
Pirate's Trove#002.dst: だが挨拶はこのへんにしよう。なあ…大海賊 Hastor 船長の話を聞いたことはあるか？遥か昔に海を渡った男だ。
Pirate's Trove#002.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#003.src: Legend says that when {p} was rebuilt all those years ago, he hid his fortune within the walls someplace!
Pirate's Trove#003.dst: 伝説によれば、昔 {p} が再建されたとき、奴は城壁のどこかに財宝を隠したそうだ！
Pirate's Trove#003.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#004.src: I'm a retired sailor now, but I could still do with a few extra emeralds from that treasure. Perhaps, if you're up to it... we could come to an agreement?
Pirate's Trove#004.dst: 俺はもう引退した船乗りだが、その財宝から少しエメラルドをいただけるならありがたい。どうだ、やる気があるなら…取引といかないか？
Pirate's Trove#004.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#005.src: I have a riddle, the first of a number of clues that are supposed to lead to where Hastor hid his fortune, but I can't for the life of me figure it out.
Pirate's Trove#005.dst: 謎かけを一つ持っている。Hastor の隠し場所へ導く手がかりの最初の一つなんだが、どうしても解けんのだ。
Pirate's Trove#005.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#006.src: Maybe you'll be able to solve it. If you can, I'll make sure to split the treasure with you!
Pirate's Trove#006.dst: お前なら解けるかもしれん。解けたら、財宝は必ず山分けにしよう！
Pirate's Trove#006.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#007.src: This first riddle goes like so: “Toward the sunset, among the northern flowers shaded by quartz”.
Pirate's Trove#007.dst: 最初の謎はこうだ。「日の沈む方、石英に陰る北の花々の間に」。
Pirate's Trove#007.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#008.src: I do wish you good luck, adventurer! Remember, everything you need to solve the clues should be found somewhere inside {p}.
Pirate's Trove#008.dst: 幸運を祈るぞ、冒険者！いいか、手がかりを解くのに必要なものは、すべて {p} の中のどこかにあるはずだ。
Pirate's Trove#008.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#009.src: Clue I: Toward the sunset, among northern flowers shaded by quartz
Pirate's Trove#009.dst: 手がかり I: 日の沈む方、石英に陰る北の花々の間に

Pirate's Trove#010.src: Clue II: In a place of identity, above the leaves and between the glass
Pirate's Trove#010.dst: 手がかり II: 身元の場所にて、葉の上、ガラスの間に

Pirate's Trove#011.src: Clue III: In an emerald fountain, surrounded by the wealth of the villagers
Pirate's Trove#011.dst: 手がかり III: エメラルドの泉にて、村人の富に囲まれて

Pirate's Trove#012.src: Clue IV: Beneath the cowl of an eastern titan, keeping watch over our heads
Pirate's Trove#012.dst: 手がかり IV: 東の巨人の頭巾の下、我らの頭上を見守る

Pirate's Trove#013.src: Aha! I'd come to ask how it was coming when I saw you jump over here!
Pirate's Trove#013.dst: おお！様子を聞きに来たら、お前がこっちへ跳んでくるのが見えたぞ！
Pirate's Trove#013.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#014.src: Phenomenal work, my compatriot. Though, do remember our deal?
Pirate's Trove#014.dst: 見事な働きだ、相棒よ。ところで、約束は覚えているな？
Pirate's Trove#014.speaker: Damiral

Pirate's Trove#015.src: You find the treasure, I give you a cut. I'll just take my part and be on my way!
Pirate's Trove#015.dst: 財宝を見つけたら分け前をやる。俺は自分の分をもらって行くとしよう！
Pirate's Trove#015.speaker: Damiral
